high_sugar_warning: Numbers are high this time, hero. We need to review our routine immediately.
high_sugar_msg: The numbers are quite heavy this time, hero ($avg). We need to review our routine immediately and contact the doctor if this continues. Our health is no joke, and we want to get back 'on track' as soon as possible.
low_sugar_msg: Notice the average is leaning towards a drop? It feels like the battery is running out. Try to adjust your meals and always keep a quick snack with you to stay safe and full of energy.
new_warrior_msg: Welcome to the Heroes Club! Diabetes isn't a battle; it's just a new friend that needs some time for you to understand and organize your cards with. A right start is half the way.
weight_msg: Hero, your body is asking to lighten the load a bit. A simple daily walk will put your body's response in a completely different place, and you'll feel the difference in how 'smooth' your numbers become.
insulin_msg: Since 'The Maestro' (Insulin) is the one settting the performance, precision in timing is the secret. Your commitment is what will always keep you a 'boss' in the green zone.
youth_msg: You are at the peak of your energy; don't let diabetes distract you from your dreams. A few simple carb calculations and you'll live your day like a king. The important thing is to always keep your 'eyes on the prize'.
general_msg: Excellent performance and honorable numbers! You are truly 'on track'. Continue with this same spirit; your health is always your true capital.
no_data_msg: ✨ Not enough data yet. Start logging your readings so we can analyze your performance.
type1_perfect_plan: Your average is very safe! Stay consistent with the same food routine next week, and you'll remain a 'pro' at managing your sugar.
type1_low_plan: The average is leaning low. Suggested Routine: Review insulin doses with your doctor, and ensure your snacks are sufficient before physical activity.
type1_high_plan: The average is a bit higher than required. Suggested Routine: We need to increase water intake and reduce simple carbs in your dinner next week.
type2_perfect_plan: Great job, hero! This average is ideal for Type 2. Your routine for next week is 'Maintaining Achievements'; keep up the exercise and healthy eating.
type2_warning_plan: The average needs a pause. Suggested Routine: Try adding a 15-minute walk after lunch next week and reduce direct sugars—you'll find the numbers have changed completely.
